source_claim: Hololive's official profile confirms Ookami Mio and identifies Miofa as her fan name, but the checked official routes do not identify the four exact mascot-character tags in this campaign or establish their HOME mapping.

checked_routes.result: The talent page identifies Ookami Mio and gives Miofa (みおーんファミリー) as her fan name, but it does not list Hatotaurus, Taiga, or Tawa as characters or provide a roster matching all four exact campaign tags.
The official live report refers to Miofa as the fans/audience (including the 'Miofa tree') and not as a named fictional-character roster; it does not establish the four exact campaign identities.
The official goods directory links the Hololive Production shop but the checked directory page itself contains no Mio mascot catalog or exact campaign member mapping.

notes: PARTIAL only. The campaign covers multiple mascot entities and these profile/event/shop routes do not exhaust it. No negative or terminal relation is proposed.
